warmup: pnpm exec supabase start && pnpm exec supabase stop

supabase.cmd: pnpm exec supabase start && exec docker logs -f --since 1s supabase_db_app

web.cmd: : start Next.js with the Supabase URL and key; a cold first start pulls images for longer than depends_on waits; out=; for i in $(seq 150); do out=$(pnpm exec supabase status -o env 2>/dev/null) && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '^API_URL="http' && break; out=; sleep 2; done; [ -n "$out" ] || exit 1; v() { printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n "s/^$1=\"\\(.*\\)\"$/\\1/p" | head -n1; }; SUPABASE_URL=$(v API_URL); SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$(v PUBLISHABLE_KEY); [ -n "$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" ] || SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$(v ANON_KEY); export SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; exec pnpm dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3000}
